player.name: Mohammad Wildan Yanuar
player.tagline: I build and ship fintech products at ALAMI. Started as a backend developer, moved to deciding what gets built.

quests.title: The Accounting Migration
quests.situation: Oracle's accounting platform cost the company IDR 2–5 billion a year — finance needed a cheaper system without breaking a live, audited ledger.
quests.task: Migrate every financial record from Oracle to Jurnal before the Oracle contract expired, with full data integrity and zero disruption to daily accounting.
quests.action: Mapped every Oracle use case to its Jurnal equivalent, extracted and backed up the full historical dataset, ran weekly sync meetings to unblock engineering, verified migrated records line by line, wrote the integration requirements between the internal MINA system and Jurnal, and trained the finance team before cutover.
quests.result: 100% of journal vouchers migrated and verified, the MINA–Jurnal integration shipped cleanly, and the team was fully live on Jurnal a month before the Oracle contract ended.
quests.xp: ~IDR 1.6 billion saved in annual operating cost

quests.title: Updating Agreement Document
quests.situation: ALAMI's Funder umbrella agreement needed updating — new consumer data protection clauses, updated bondholder meeting terms, and other regulatory changes all had to be folded in.
quests.task: Get every Funder onto the new umbrella agreement without breaking their existing one or blocking anyone from signing.
quests.action: Wrote the requirements for the new agreement content and how Funders would access and sign it, ran a cost analysis for the rollout, mapped the downside risks and who was authorized to sign, released the new agreement in staged batches to limit blast radius, and built the Funder-facing communication explaining what changed and why they needed to re-sign.
quests.result: New Funders are fully on the updated agreement; most existing Funders are still on the old one while the team weighs trimming the content further to cut the cost of repeated signature rounds.

quests.title: Onboarding Under New Regulation
quests.situation: ALAMI had rolled out a new internal credit score, but Funders — who make the final financing call — hadn't been told what it meant for their exposure.
quests.task: Design and ship a notification flow that told Funders about the new credit scoring model and what would change for them.
quests.action: Wrote the requirements for how the new credit score would surface to Funders, tested the flow engineering built against it, and drafted the Funder-facing email announcing the change.
quests.result: Funders got clear, timely information about the credit score change, which kept complaints about it to a minimum.
quests.xp: Minimal Funder complaints after the change shipped
